reasoning: This is a Go service that implements an HTTP reverse proxy designed to run as a Kubernetes sidecar container. It listens on a configurable port (default 8000), intercepts OpenAI-compatible chat/completions requests, and routes them between prefill and decode workers in an LLM disaggregated prefill/decode (P/D) architecture. It supports multiple P/D connector protocols (NIXL v1, NIXL v2, LMCache), includes SSRF protection via InferencePool allowlisting, and provides TLS termination. The project has a standalone main binary entry point, a Dockerfile for container image builds, and Kubernetes deployment manifests (StatefulSet, Service, RBAC). It is not an operator (no CRDs, no controller-runtime reconciliation loops), not a library (produces a runnable binary, not an importable package), and not configuration-only.
